confirmatory_analysis.multiplicity: Only slot-29 exact discovery is confirmatory; all other endpoints are descriptive.
confirmatory_analysis.paired_counts: Among discordant tasks, W is llm-only success and L is grammar-random-only success.
practical_thresholds: llm exact successes are at least 6 of 12
llm exact successes minus grammar-random exact successes is at least 4
confirmatory_analysis.primary_endpoint: semantic exact discovery at or before logical slot 29
confirmatory_analysis.primary_p_value: one-sided exact paired sign-test tail sum_{k=W}^{W+L} choose(W+L,k)/2^(W+L); p=1 when W+L=0
secondary_endpoints: ESS, unique terminal programs, grammar-restart draws, scorer calls, cache hits, invalid slots, tokens, and elapsed time
confirmatory_analysis.study_success_rule: p<=0.05 and both practical thresholds hold, with no method-integrity abort

failure_policy.infrastructure_policy: A preflight or process failure outside totalized harness semantics aborts the confirmatory attempt; it is not converted into a favorable arm outcome. Publish the aborted attempt and do not silently resume under the same method seal.
method_integrity_abort: source, prompt, semantic setting, seed, task, or sealed byte drift
private target leakage before the public artifact bundle is sealed
unlogged retry, backfill, task replacement, or completion call before the provider seal
missing or structurally incomplete 29-slot result for either matched arm
baseline policy mismatch or any grammar-random provider call
valid_algorithmic_failures: provider timeout, HTTP error, malformed response, invalid expression, or missing slot that the frozen harness totalizes and records
failure to discover a semantic zero-loss program within exactly 29 logical slots

prompt_template_binding.scheme: SHA256(domain || NUL || repeated(path || NUL || exact_file_bytes || NUL))

test_bundle.scheme: SHA256(domain || NUL || repeated(path || NUL || exact_file_bytes || NUL))

matched_design.common_random_numbers: The two arms share the task-specific start, proposal-mixture sample, and resampling seeds; only provider and random-shortlist acquisition have distinct frozen seeds.
matched_design.replacement_policy: No task or arm replacement is permitted after generation.
matched_design.run_order: For each task run grammar-random first, then llm; finish and seal both before starting the next task.

allowed: the current task's public input-output examples
the current complete program and structured interpreter feedback
the typed local grammar productions and allowed constant interval
forbidden: suite secret, private reveal, hidden target AST, commitment nonce, or rejection log
complete program support count or catalog
other task identities, prompts, outputs, or run outcomes
matched-random outputs or posthoc exhaustive results
model_information_boundary.provider_request_audit: Every exact request and response byte sequence is retained; a public pre-unblinding audit must verify forbidden fields and explicit cardinalities never occur.

proposal.exact_parent_semantics: Skip local proposal acquisition and use four current-state slots, but still execute every scheduled child draw from the sticky mixture.
proposal.failure_totalization: Missing, malformed, invalid, no-op, and whole-response failures map to the current state; duplicates retain multiplicity; there is no provider retry or backfill.
proposal.g: the normalized top-down recursive grammar; g(y) is the product of local rule probabilities and requires no joint-catalog enumeration
proposal.grammar_random_slots: exactly four ordered non-current, nonduplicate local expressions drawn with exact grammar weights without replacement from the selected hole; component syntax may be materialized internally, but no joint program catalog or joint support count is constructed or sent to the provider
proposal.llm_slots: exactly four ordered typed local repairs returned through structured JSON
proposal.shared_downstream_mechanics: Both arms use the same hole selection, totalization, mixture sampler, importance weights, stage targets, resampling code, execution oracle, and 29-slot budget.

required_claim_limits: Evidence concerns this frozen target distribution, model revision, and 29-slot budget only.
A positive result supports bounded exact-discovery advantage over this grammar-random local proposal arm, not exhaustive-search or asymptotic speedup.
Importance accounting concerns the declared weighted SMC target and does not itself guarantee exact discovery.
The provider can derive facts from the public grammar, but neither the prompt nor the algorithm explicitly receives or requires the full support cardinality.

stage_order: freeze exact method protocol and external method-seal hash
custodian creates a new 32-byte secret and publishes only its commitment
custodian seals that commitment before task generation
generate the public suite and private reveal exactly once
seal exact public task and endpoint-health bytes before completion calls
complete and publicly seal both matched arms for all 12 tasks
run reveal-free confirmatory analysis and seal it
unblind and verify commitments only after the public artifact seal

deterministic_rejection_condition: the predicate retains between three and five values on the public observed domain
the mapper produces at least three distinct values on retained domain inputs
task_distribution.duplicate_policy: Independent draws are never replaced merely because another task has the same syntax or finite-domain behavior.
examples_in_order: all eight singleton lists in ascending domain order
the complete domain in ascending order
explicitly_forbidden_generation_dependen: search start state or any run seed
another task or a family quota
syntactic alias multiplicity or human difficulty judgment

independent_target_draw.joint: draw predicate and mapper independently from their normalized top-down laws
independent_target_draw.mapper: choose uniformly among item, constant, op(item,item), op(item,c), and op(c,item); within a form choose op uniformly from add/sub/mul and c uniformly when present
independent_target_draw.predicate: choose atom versus ordered conjunction with probability one half; each atom chooses uniformly among lt(item,c), lt(c,item), and eq(item,c), then uniformly chooses c

task_distribution.sampling_rule: For each task independently, accept the first domain-separated secret-derived draw satisfying only the two frozen informativeness checks.
task_distribution.success_semantics: semantic zero loss on every public example; no claim of unique hidden-AST recovery
